name: Tooltip
description: `Tooltip` provides supplementary text for a trigger.

props.name: keybindingHint
props.description:
Keyboard shortcut, or alternative shortcuts, shown after the tooltip text. Uses the `KeybindingHint` key syntax,
such as `Mod+B`. Assistive technology receives the shortcut as plain text in the trigger's description.

props.name: type
props.description:
How the tooltip relates to its trigger. `description` adds supplementary text through `aria-describedby`.
`label` repeats the trigger's accessible name visually, so the trigger must already be named, for example
with `aria-label`; the tooltip is then hidden from assistive technology.

props.name: keybindingHint
props.description:
Keyboard shortcut, or alternative shortcuts, shown after the tooltip text. Uses the `KeybindingHint` key syntax,
such as `Mod+B`. Assistive technology receives the shortcut as plain text in the trigger's description.

props.name: type
props.description:
How the tooltip relates to its trigger. `description` adds supplementary text through `aria-describedby`.
`label` repeats the trigger's accessible name visually, so the trigger must already be named, for example
with `aria-label`; the tooltip is then hidden from assistive technology.

props.name: align
props.description: Alignment of the content along the anchor's edge.

props.name: alignOffset
props.description: Shift in pixels along the anchor's edge, or a callback that computes it from the measured sizes.

props.name: anchor
props.description: Positions the content against this anchor instead of the trigger, such as an element rendered elsewhere.

props.name: keepMounted
props.description:
Keeps the popup in the DOM while closed so `aria-describedby` always resolves. Defaults to `true` when the
trigger is described by the tooltip: description tooltips, and label tooltips with a keybinding hint.

props.name: portal
props.description: Where the content is rendered in the DOM. Set `false` to keep it in place.

props.name: positionerClassName
props.description: Classes applied to the element that positions the content.

props.name: side
props.description: Side of the anchor the content opens on.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Distance in pixels between the content and its anchor, or a callback that computes it.
